boxes.title: Nehru Report vs 14 Points
items: **Birkenhead** challenged Indians to frame a constitution
**Nehru Report (1928)**: **All Parties Conference**, **9** members; chair **Motilal**, secy **Jawaharlal**
**Jinnah's 14 Points (1929)**: federal, residuary powers to provinces, ==**one-third** Muslim seats at Centre==

boxes.title: GoI Act 1935
items: ==**321 sections, 10 schedules**== (⚠ other notes: 14 parts); basis: Simon + **3 RTCs** + **White Paper**
**All-India Federation** (optional for states): never formed; Centre dyarchy never operated
**RBI**: Act **1934** (Hilton Young, **1926**); started **1 April 1935**; nationalised **1 Jan 1949**

boxes.title: Elections & more 1919 detail
items: Congress ministries resigned **Oct-Nov 1939** (WWII); League **Day of Deliverance** **22 Dec 1939**
Swarajists (**C.R. Das, Motilal**) won about **40%** seats; Justice Party in office most of **1920-37**
**ICS exams** in India from **1922** (Allahabad, later Delhi)
1909: elected members, largely **indirect** and separate electorates
